description: Branching model where developers merge small, frequent updates into a single main branch daily.
Lightweight branch-based workflow where short-lived feature branches are merged into main after PR approval and automated testing.
Legacy branching model using multiple long-lived branches for development, releases, and hotfixes.
Condition occurring when competing code changes are made to the same file, requiring reconciliation before integration.
Operational friction where developers avoid merging long-lived branches due to high conflict complexity.
Git branch intended to exist for less than 24 hours before being merged back into the primary trunk.
